div.div: هُوَ فَغِمٌ بِهِ (S, TA) and بِهِ ↓ مُفْغَمٌ (K, TA) He is attached to it, fond of it, or eagerly desirous of it. (S, K, TA.) And كَلْبٌ فَغِمٌ عَلَى الصَّيْدِ [A dog attached, &c., or accustomed, or habituated, (see 1,) to the chase]: (S:) or كَلْبٌ فَغِمٌ [alone] a dog eagerly desirous of the chase. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
